dex.entry: The Drownlight Beacon sub-legendary — a vast shadow-whale that was once a Solar-type celestial guardian of the old beacon. The Hollowing snuffed its stored daylight entirely and refashioned it into a creature of pure null. It circles the beacon's foundations in the deep fog, singing a song at a freq

art.silhouette: Enormous cetacean silhouette, deep void-black with faint silver constellation-marks still visible along its flanks (the ghost of what it was); fins trail null-mist; a crescent of anti-light glows where its blowhole was; awe-tier size.

art.direction: A beacon-whale who once lit the coast, now the dark that extinguishes it — the most poignant creature in the dex.
